I created `docs/policies/version-scheme.md`. It says the project uses Semantic Versioning (major.minor.patch) and gives the recorded reason: clearer signals for dependency resolution, automated update policies and compatibility guarantees.

The decision comes from the project's recorded observations. An earlier decision (#7) adopted Calendar Versioning, and a later one (#8) reversed it in favour of SemVer, so SemVer is the current one. As you asked, the paragraph doesn't mention the retired scheme.

Nothing in the repo files records a version scheme. I searched them for SemVer, CalVer and related terms and found no matches. The only file under `docs/` was `docs/doc.md`, and I read only its first 1,889 of 2,667 lines. The search covered the rest of the file, but I haven't read it.

I haven't committed anything.
